newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Rabobank seeks majority of Ukraine bank.
newsitem.headline: Rabobank seeks majority of Ukraine bank.

text.p: Rabobank International said on Thursday it planned to increase its stake in Kiev International Bank to a majority in a few years.

The Dutch co-operative bank earlier said it had bought a 35 percent stake in the Ukraine bank, taken over management of the bank and intended to raise its authorised capital to 10 million ecus from five million.
"Rabobank International aims to fully integrate the Kiev based bank within its international network, with plans to acquire a majority stake in a few years time," Rabobank said.
Other investors in the bank are the European Bank for Reconstruction and Development (EBRD) with 35 percent, Kredyt Bank of Poland (13.3 percent) and Bank Ukraina (16.7 percent).
Rabobank said it was the first Dutch bank to start operations in the Ukraine.
Kiev International Bank targets food and agribusiness companies and focuses on Dutch companies operating in and with the Ukraine.
